family_reports.body: Panic disorder for me, son hurt himself many times, he overworked my son with excessive exercise
I went to the court trusting they would help my children and I. They have made it exponentially worse making me regret not fleeing instead.

The system has failed me and my two children! You cannot put a price on your children, and you should not have to. Every mother and father deserve to be in their children's lives! Family court is broken! Judges need to be held accountable and not protected by the system and allowed to do whatever they want. Because of false allegations that were never proven to be true,I have had to go the past four years with not getting to see my children the way that I should have and I still have three more years to go with my son. I will do whatever it takes to help change what goes on in family court anyway that I can because it has affected me so greatly.
